# AM JONIS

> SIA “AM JONIS” supplies agricultural machinery, compact loaders, tractors, concrete splitting equipment and related service in Latvia.

## Main pages

- [Latvian home](https://amjonis.lv/) — company overview, equipment, service and customer feedback.
- [English home](https://amjonis.lv/en/home-english/) — English company overview and featured equipment.
- [Latvian products](https://amjonis.lv/produkti/) — Latvian equipment catalogue.
- [English products](https://amjonis.lv/en/products/) — English equipment catalogue.
- [Contacts](https://amjonis.lv/kontakti/) — public contact information.

## Language and crawling notes

- Latvian is the primary language.
- English content is available under `/en/`.
- Prefer each page's canonical URL and its matching language version when citing content.
- Product specifications and availability can change; use the current product page as the authoritative source.
